label: PF Backlog 615
title: Gate: a feature/fix change MUST add/update a test and RUN it (no test, no merge)
body: Requirement: when a change implements a feature or fixes a defect, it must include a NEW or UPDATED test, and the fast gate must RUN those changed/new tests and require PASS, else FAIL. Today there is no such enforcement, and the scoped selection only scans test-framework/tests/pipeline (untracked new tests are missed locally; tests in other dirs are not selected). Also broaden scoped-test discovery to all test dirs and include untracked (new) test files.

objective: Enforce test coverage of changes: new/updated tests present + executed + passing, or the gate fails.
acceptance_criteria: A feature/fix change (per item type) that adds no test fails the fast gate with a clear message.
New/changed test files are (a) discovered (tracked AND untracked locally) and (b) executed in the fast gate, and must pass.
Scoped test discovery spans all test dirs (not only test-framework/tests/pipeline).
A documented exemption path exists (with recorded reason) for non-testable changes.
